items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Another fella used to come around there was Fate Marable. ... [INTERVIEWER] I remember Fate, but that was a big name then. Louis was with him.

ctx.x: So the Jeter-Pillars orchestra was the transition between Noble Sissle and Louis Armstrong.
Well, Jeter-Pillars had some good but it was also great. Had some good arrangers in St. Louis. arrangements there, Another fella used to come around there was Fate Marable.
